exam_scheme.note: The Nursing Officer Recruitment Common Eligibility Test (NORCET) is conducted centrally by the Examination Section, All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi, for direct recruitment of Nursing Officers (Group 'B' Non-Gazetted) across all participating AIIMS institutes and central government hospitals. Selection is conducted in two sequential computer-based examination stages: Stage I (NORCET Preliminary) is a qualifying screening examination of 90 minutes (100 MCQs covering General Knowledge, Aptitude, and Nursing core topics); candidates qualifying Stage I are shortlisted at 5 times the vacancies for Stage II. Stage II (NORCET Mains) is a 90-minute examination (100 MCQs) focused entirely on clinical scenarios, practical patient care, and nursing skills. Final merit and institutional allocation are determined exclusively on NORCET Mains scores.

financial_package.note: Nursing Officers in AIIMS are central government employees governed by the 7th CPC Pay Matrix under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. Officers enter at Pay Level 7 (entry basic pay ₹44,900) and are entitled to standard central allowances, Central Nursing Allowance, Uniform Allowance, and institutional health facilities.

financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 7 basic ₹44,900 + 58% DA (₹26,042) + HRA ranging from 10% (Z city, ₹4,490) to 30% (X metro city / AIIMS New Delhi, ₹13,470) + Transport Allowance (₹3,600 + 58% DA = ₹5,688 in higher TPTA cities) + Nursing Allowance of ₹7,200 per month. Net in-hand reflects 10% NPS deduction (₹7,094) and standard payroll taxes.
official_perks: Nursing Allowance of ₹7,200 per month as sanctioned by Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Annual Uniform Allowance of ₹21,600 (₹1,800 per month) for maintenance of standard clinical nursing attire
Central HRA (30%/20%/10% based on city category) or subsidized on-campus residential accommodation at AIIMS complexes
Comprehensive cashless medical facilities and priority healthcare coverage across AIIMS for employee and dependent family
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% defined monthly employer contribution by Government of India
Children Education Allowance (CEA) of ₹2,250 per month per child and Leave Travel Concession (LTC) entitlements
